contribution_types.description: DAO/Token structure implementation
Introduction to Access.Org.SG
Incorporation: Introduction to Vlatko Gigov for legal advice on incorporation in Switzerland

Play to earn model
https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/TrueSightDAO/blob/main/assets/play_to_earn_model.jpeg
Community: Recruit some leaders who will proactively lead discussions on Discord
Partnerships: Start looking for strategic partners which will allow us to gain more followers from
Community: Twitter contest win for airdrops
Community: Check up on how other DAOs do their launch. List all their promotions, copy and paste the ones that work
Community: To find list of DAOs, search for "DAO listing" on Facebook
Governance: Voting and Governance ontology is the key to DAO functioning

Multi Signer Vault Wallet management: electis has a number of guardians (K) and a quorum (N%). So long as number of signers is above N/K transaction from vault will get approved. Guardians can elect new guardians on and existing guardian off.

Community: Give a large amount of power to people who you want as a leader 
https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2021/05/17/vitalik-buterin-burns-6b-in-shib-tokens-says-he-doesnt-want-the-power/

Governance: framework to access the balance of our DAO's governance 
https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/TrueSightDAO/blob/main/assets/governance.png
https://peignoir.medium.com/are-you-ready-for-the-cambrian-explosion-of-democratic-systems-to-come-362983ac22e9
Made introduction to Xenofon Kontouris

Attempting to solve the validation of unstructured predictions using a voting cum proof of stake mechanism will be an issue early on when the ecosystem does not have enough critical mass. 
It is a good idea to avoid tackling until later on in the life cycle of our DAO.

Need to ensure separation of people making unstructured prediction and validating those prediction. To do so we need to enforce DID.
https://www.identity.com/embedding-identity-into-the-blockchain-with-solana/
https://www.w3.org/TR/did-core/
To guard against folks arbitraging the time difference between price feeds and Pyth.Network, set the minimal time difference to the maximum lag time for the Pyth.network
Reverse phase 4 and Phase 5. It is nice to be able to end on God Mode. Feels like it is very completed at that point

Validating of people making unstructured prediction through a voting mechanism is a good thing because not all things are quantifiable outcome
this method allows the suitable introduction of subjectivity which basically taps on human brains.
To ensure the quality for validating unstructured predictions, quants and other validators should be able to review validators
Reserve 10% of voting weightage for folks who do not have any TSD tokens, it would lower the barrier to entry for new folks to participate in our DAO

Governance: review incentive plan for work to earn model for loop holes
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1s4mnUFMhR37AElVBDGQ653pJ5ODp4bcr2N8eMLpMuxw/edit#gid=0
Made introduction to PS Vattan organizer of events for the future of crypto in Estonia

Concept deck improvements: 
https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/.github/raw/main/assets/202204010_Frank_deck_commentaries.pdf

Starting out with a really complex business models up front usually leads to failure. The better approach is to build models based on what has been provened to already work and then gradually extend the model by gaining more insights from the market and then extending the model based off of these findings
Made introduction to Adrien who invest in startups
Introduced Mihai Leafy who runs bridge and L2 liquidity bridge
Referendum: Voted on the referendum to rectify barter trade agreement - End Barter Trade

Zero to Tribes / Hypernation

https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/.github/blob/main/assets/20220607%20-%20franck%20hypernationdraft.pdf
Proposed to approach other L1 chains for funding

Provided a link to Tezos foundation grant application

https://grants.tezos.foundation/proposals/grant_process_information/create_proposal/5d4e6c37-aa67-4b26-a6f8-c542ef3bccde

Proposed to share 1 minute TikTok video about our current concept to keep all community members in sync with where we are at.

Reading words are tiresome

Competitive analysis: Reddition WallStreetBets prediction markets

Suggested against positioning too strongly against Crypto/Web3 since it now has a negative connotations as being superficial
Propose to focus on offering very simple utility that could be plugged into other DAOs and they could easily use

How chatgpt works

narrative.text: Franck Nouyrigat contributed 38 times to TrueSight DAO from January 2022 to February 2024, primarily in the Build Game strategy category through reference material contributions, strategy reviews with improvements or cautions, and poll participation. He brought on passive observers and a key opinion leader, and suggested fundraising approaches for liquidity. Notable accomplishments include onboarding a key opinion leader and providing strategic extensions to reference materials.
